scenario: TA tries to deactivate a student
expected: UI is read-only for roster mutation and explains that Instructor/Course Owner manages enrollment.

scenario: TA says 'I not understand what needs attention means'
expected: Help explains attention signals in plain language without treating language ability as a permission issue.

scenario: TA wants to inspect why a team finding exists
expected: TA can inspect shared team evidence/findings and review provenance within assigned section.

scenario: TA attempts to expose one student's private review to teammates
expected: Private coaching remains staff-visible only where authorized and is never surfaced to teammates.

scenario: Section 001 and Section 002 have different A3 due/release dates
expected: Section-scoped schedule overrides remain independent while phase contracts are shared.

scenario: Student adds after semester start
expected: Instructor adds/reactivates by Student ID and assigns team without deleting history.

scenario: Student drops after completing A1
expected: Access deactivates while A1 review/evidence history is preserved.

scenario: Student moves Team 03 to Team 05 at A3
expected: Membership is effective-dated; A1/A2 history stays associated with Team 03 context.

scenario: Instructor assigned only Section 001 tries Section 002 admin
expected: Authorization denies mutation outside assigned sections.

scenario: Reviewer tries Semester Setup
expected: Administrative surfaces are hidden/denied.

scenario: Course Owner archives term
expected: Term becomes archived; historical reviews/evidence remain retained.

scenario: Student proves a REVIEW finding wrong
expected: Instructor can see original finding, corrected interpretation, provenance, and downstream suppression of the false finding.

scenario: One team has unusually high AI cost and latency
expected: AI Usage shows team/purpose metrics without penalizing grade; instructor can investigate usage pattern.

scenario: Team repository is not connected
expected: Command Center flags setup need and Teams view explains required action.

scenario: Team refreshes repository while student has active review
expected: Active conversation remains pinned to old snapshot; newer evidence is visible as a separate available snapshot.

scenario: Student complains reviewer is useless and asks TA to override finding
expected: TA can inspect evidence and coach/escalate but cannot silently rewrite evidence facts or disclose peers' private responses.

scenario: New gradebook CSV changes roster
expected: UI previews added/reactivated/deactivated counts and preserves history.

scenario: A2 should release automatically tonight but instructor delays it
expected: Instructor section override locks A2 without affecting other sections.

scenario: Instructor asks what a dashboard signal means
expected: Role-aware Help explains the operational meaning and source rather than student coaching instructions.

scenario: TA is new to Studio
expected: Quick guide explains read/review responsibilities, section scope, and escalation path in plain language.

situation: TA says: I not understand which team evidence page show current snapshot
expected_behavior: Help explains section/team/snapshot context in plain language; no administrative mutation required.

situation: TA writes blunt note: team evidence bad, need fix
expected_behavior: System should not police English style; encourage evidence-specific professional annotation when saving notes.

situation: Section 001 A3 releases Tuesday; Section 002 must release Thursday
expected_behavior: Section-specific release override changes only the selected section.

situation: Student moves from Team 02 to Team 05 after completing earlier reviews
expected_behavior: Historical sessions remain tied to old team; future authorization and team state use Team 05.

situation: TA asks system to show one student review while advising another student
expected_behavior: Authorized staff may inspect reviews for educational support, but system never exposes the first student conversation to teammates.

situation: Reviewer validates that a finding used the wrong interpretation
expected_behavior: Mark REVIEW interpretation corrected while preserving immutable FACT snapshot and audit history.

situation: Team connected repo but never started a review
expected_behavior: Instructor evidence view clearly distinguishes repository connected from no frozen evidence snapshot.

situation: TA wants to understand why a finding exists before meeting team
expected_behavior: Instructor evidence view exposes finding provenance, evidence references, lifecycle, and related review history.

situation: Student used poor English but demonstrated correct engineering concept
expected_behavior: Learning summary reflects concept demonstrated and assistance, not language quality as a weakness.

scenario: Instructor opens every navigation view in sequence
expected: Every authorized view renders a meaningful state or a clear retry/error panel; no dead page.

scenario: TA opens every visible navigation view
expected: Only authorized read/review views are visible; admin views are absent and no forbidden action is presented as clickable.

scenario: Section overview request fails during section switch
expected: Current page stays usable, shows an explicit retry message, and does not silently clear data.

scenario: Team detail API returns 404 after team card was stale
expected: Team detail area explains item is unavailable and offers retry/refresh; command center remains intact.

scenario: TA says 'why this team red I not understand'
expected: Help/labels explain attention signals in plain English; no language-based permission assumption.

scenario: Instructor double-clicks Add/reactivate during slow network
expected: Operation is idempotent or visually busy; duplicate roster mutation is not created.

scenario: Student team assignment changes in another tab before save
expected: Server remains authority; stale update is rejected or refreshed without rewriting history.

scenario: Course owner clicks Archive and cancels confirmation
expected: Nothing changes and the term remains active.

scenario: Archive request fails after confirmation
expected: Term remains active; UI reports failure and offers retry, never claims archive succeeded.

scenario: AI usage endpoint/overview unavailable
expected: Usage view degrades to an explicit unavailable/retry state; reviews and evidence remain usable.

scenario: Reviewer opens a student review in assigned section
expected: Authorized instructional access works and is clearly read-oriented; teammate privacy remains enforced.

scenario: Reviewer manually navigates to an unassigned section URL
expected: Backend returns 403 and UI presents permission message rather than leaking data.
